newsitem.title: IRAN: Quake shakes Iranian city, no casualty reports.
newsitem.headline: Quake shakes Iranian city, no casualty reports.

text.p: A minor earthquake shook the city of Bojnourd in Iran's northeast Khorasan province late on Saturday, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Sunday.

The tremor, which measured 4.8 on the open-ended Richter scale, destroyed a number of homes which had been damaged in a two previous quakes in February, the agency said. It did not mention any casualties.
In early February two earthquakes measuring 6.1 and 5.4 on the Richter scale killed at least 79 people and injured 260 in and around Bojnourd.
A force four earthquake is powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
